title: [P0] Compile, import, cook and play-test the UE5 Windows prototype
body:
The 0.3 sprint supplies a UE5.6 C++ project, shared map data and four original OBJ exports, but no Unreal installation was available and no native build has run.

Scope: native/MansouraTaxi and Tools/build-native.ps1. Resolve real UHT/C++ and editor import failures on a supported Windows host; verify materials, mesh centimetre bounds, open gate collisions, Arabic HUD shaping and cook inclusion.

Acceptance:
- Editor and packaged Development Win64 builds succeed from a clean checkout using the documented helper.
- Fresh bootstrap-result.json and native-build.json match the exported manifest and executable.
- A recorded drive covers forward/reverse, steering, braking, recovery, pause and four independent riders with no duplicate payments.
- Publish engine/toolchain versions, runtime logs and actual screenshots. Node tests are not a substitute for this check.

Depends on a suitable UE host; no native build success is claimed by the current sprint.

title: [P0] Provision and validate an authenticated GPU Pixel Streaming session
body:
The local Radeon 530/UHD 620 device cannot deliver the requested Lumen-quality game. No suitable Windows GPU cloud host is connected, and no working Unreal stream exists. The ordinary Codex cloud code environment is not a provisioned game server.

Scope: select an accessible GPU provider/host after confirming cost constraints, install an engine-supported toolchain and matching Epic PixelStreamingInfrastructure branch, and use a successfully packaged native executable.

Acceptance:
- Record GPU, encoder and driver support and measure packaged performance at an agreed resolution/quality.
- Verify browser video, original game audio, held driving inputs, disconnect/reconnect and session cleanup.
- Remote access has an authenticated player endpoint, TLS and suitable TURN/network configuration; preserve owner-private access.
- Document measured latency/frame times, operating cost and shutdown behavior.

Tools/start-stream.ps1 currently launches only against an already prepared loopback service; it does not create a cloud host or public endpoint. Depends on the native build issue.

title: [P0] Survey and reconstruct the Al Mashaya–Al Gomhouria–university buildings
body:
The user's core requirement is recognisable, individually faithful Mansoura buildings. Generic extrusion of 2,697 OSM footprints plus 150 inferred frontage blocks does not meet it. Only Administration, Metro frontage and Law Gate 3 are photo-referenced; none are survey-verified and no similarity percentage is established.

Scope: create a dated, geolocated street-by-street reference log for both sides of the selected route; record camera position/direction, facade dimensions, shops, balconies, entrances, rooflines, signage and unresolved/occluded surfaces. Obtain any necessary asset permissions and keep source attribution.

Acceptance:
- Replace procedural frontage per building using documented current references, keeping source footprint/road topology.
- Review fixed in-game camera comparisons against the corresponding real views at matching position and focal length.
- Define a measurable visual acceptance rubric with the user before assigning a percentage; do not relabel inferred or hidden features as exact.
- Update assets/building-references.json with evidence, dates, dimensions, model status and outstanding gaps.

Start with visible buildings around the current Law Gate 3 approach, then continue the full chosen corridor.

title: [P0] Reconstruct the governorate, stadium, courts, hospitals and clubs from matched references
body:
The 0.3 destination catalog adds real location evidence and estimated road stops, but the requested landmark architecture is not individually reconstructed. Include مبنى المحافظة، استاد المنصورة، مجمع المحاكم، العام القديم/التخصصي، العام الجديد/الدولي، الباطنة التخصصي، الطوارئ، جزيرة الورد، الحوار and Touril streets.

Scope: data/destination-sources.json, assets/destinations.json, building reference catalog and original browser/native models.

Identity constraints:
- El Geish court complex differs from the old El Gomhouria complex and Council of State buildings.
- Governorate currently uses the citizen-service centre pin, not a surveyed main-building centroid; reject the conflicting Saber Nakhala listing until independently resolved.
- Preserve the existing sporting stadium ID 614809959; do not duplicate it or substitute university sports facilities.
- Old General/Specialized is one destination, distinct from university Specialized Medical Hospital.

Acceptance: independently verify exact public approaches, compound footprints and dated elevations, model the actual named buildings and street furniture, and produce matched camera reviews with outstanding hidden details explicitly tracked. Keep safe public-street taxi stops separate from surveyed gate coordinates.

title: [P1] Finish the Verna rig and calibrate native vehicle handling
body:
The original Verna-inspired source model is exported at plausible centimetre dimensions. Native driving uses a Chaos rigid body with four trace-wheel suspension contacts, front-wheel drive, gears and friction estimates. It has not been driven in Unreal; the imported vehicle remains one static mesh.

Acceptance:
- Separate and animate steering/wheels, suspension, lights, cabin and visible passengers with correct pivots.
- Calibrate mass, centre of gravity, torque/gearing, brakes, tyre limits and suspension using sourced Verna data and controlled drives.
- Measure acceleration, stopping distance, turning radius, reverse, slopes, curbs, handbrake and collision stability at multiple frame rates.
- Avoid claiming measured handling accuracy until the recorded checks pass.

Depends on the native build/runtime baseline.

title: [P1] Port directed road navigation and full shared-taxi gameplay to UE
body:
The browser fare engine supports independent passengers, negotiation, pooling disclosure, patience, early exits and separate payments with simulation tests. Native source currently implements only a first four-rider loop and straight-line destination selection.

Acceptance:
- Port the directed OSM road graph and legal-return routing; never guide a taxi through buildings, water or the wrong way.
- Preserve separate destinations, agreed quotes, pooling disclosures, due drop-off priority and no duplicate payments for four concurrent riders.
- Add haggle, patience/detour consequences and stopped safe early exits using original Egyptian comedy.
- Record a complete native multi-passenger shift and include meaningful simulation and packaged-runtime checks.
- Keep key actions available through a small corner HUD; Tab must clear optional information from the road view.

title: [P1] Produce original Egyptian street voices and a spatial Mansoura soundscape
body:
Browser ambience currently synthesizes road noise and horns, with original Arabic callouts spoken only if a system Arabic voice is available; otherwise captions appear. These are not recorded Egyptian actors. Native currently has a synthesized horn and text, not the complete soundscape.

Acceptance:
- Produce licensed/original Egyptian performances for drivers, passengers, university gates, shoe/scarf vendors and microbus calls, with a reviewed script and asset provenance.
- Add spatial traffic, market/crowd beds, horn variety, taxi engine changes and occlusion/distance mixing in UE.
- Verify sound starts on the player's choice, captions remain readable, mute/pause stop callouts and sound survives browser streaming/reconnect.
- Keep voices intelligible without constant repetition or copying real people's recordings.

Use assets/egyptian-street-lines.json as original script material, not as proof recorded audio exists.

title: [P1] Validate dense university street life, traffic and unobstructed gameplay
body:
The sprint adds moving university crowds, interpreted shoe/scarf stands, rural visitors and more microbuses. Stand placements and populations are interpretations, not a survey. Native source starts with 112 ambient vehicles and 140 pedestrians; their performance and behavior have not been measured in Unreal.

Acceptance:
- Keep people/stands on validated walkable space, preserve actual gates, and avoid obstructing a drivable lane with unverified placement.
- Test traffic queues, intersections, microbus stops, taxi interactions and pedestrian crossings without deadlocks or persistent overlap.
- Profile LOD/instances, animation and audio on the chosen GPU host and document actual frame time.
- Review daytime/nighttime chase and cabin views and desktop/phone streamed controls; preserve a clear centre road view during negotiation and four-rider trips.
- Supply screenshots and a real play session for the performance and visibility claims.
